description: Team Quantam Quest is a group of six first-year B.Tech CSE (Cyber Security) students at KTU working on . We combine research, design, and documentation skills, with each member taking a defined role, to deliver a clear and well-presented outcome.
summary: This is a moon-base survival game where the player controls an astronaut on the moon, manages Air and Food levels, collects rocks to earn points, and uses those points to buy and place items like Solar Panel, Food Crop, Air Dome and Lab from the shop to build and maintain a complete moon base. The player can move with arrow keys / A-D, switch between items, place them, and use them to survive, while Food Crops give food, Air Domes increase air, Solar Panels give power, and the Lab helps in doing experiments. If Air or Food becomes low, the player has to act fast, and the main goal is to collect more points, keep resources full, and expand the base to survive longer on the moon.
details:
How it works

  • Stats to manage: Air, Food, Energy, Health and Radiation. You start with Energy at 0%.
  • Controls: A/D to move, E to place an item, F to interact, Q to switch items and B to open the shop. There are also on-screen buttons for touch devices.
  • Low gravity: Your astronaut hops when walking, and walking uses food faster.

Mission objectives

  1. Install your starter solar panel to generate energy. It only works in daylight, so you need to store energy to get through the lunar night.
  2. Collect moon rocks and rare purple special stones for points.
  3. Build an air dome. Crops only grow inside it, and it constantly uses energy.
  4. Run lab experiments, each costing one special stone and 30 energy.
  5. Build a radiation shelter. It uses energy constantly and weakens over time, and repairs and upgrades cost a lot of energy.
